title: Paws and Conditions
setup: Cat and dog delegates argue over a city charter while their old identities remain encoded as ownership categories in legacy systems.
escalation: Trixie tries to settle the dispute by stripping species labels from every record. Byte warns that doing so would erase evidence of prior discrimination. Ghost searches the archive for a way to preserve history while ending automatic exclusion.
resolution: The council adopts a charter recognizing residents as persons with voluntary service access, keeps protected evidence archives and removes species restrictions from active essentials accounts. Onyx secures agreement on a shared emergency service with public oversight.
continuity: The charter is a concrete democratic step, not a single speech that cures prejudice. Accountability for former corporate actions remains intact.
comedy: The fiercest constitutional argument concerns whether pushing objects off tables is protected expression.
ending_hook: A human automated scout requests permission to inspect the landing site.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
